newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Teva awaits news on MS drug.
newsitem.headline: Teva awaits news on MS drug.

text.p: An advisory panel of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration is expected to issue its recommendation on Teva Pharmaceutical Industries' treatment for multiple sclerosis after 2000 GMT, a company spokeswoman said on Thursday.
Trading in Teva shares in Tel Aviv on Thursday will focus on speculation as to the outcome of the FDA meeting in Washington, though the results are expected well after trading has ended.
Teva, Israel's largest pharmaceutical company, has been known as a leading generic drug maker. Copaxone is key to the company's drive to become a full-fledged drug maker.
The FDA advisory panel will vote whether to recommend that the product receive final U.S. marketing approval.
Teva shares also trade on the Nasdaq and are currently at $43-1/2.

Most analysts expect a favorable vote. A positive review could send the stock over $50 and final approval in the fourth quarter could lead to over $60, according to NatWest Securities analyst Jack Lamberton.
